payload.title: Android: generic observable object store + sync loop (StateFlow)
payload.description: Kotlin parity with FR-136 (Swift generic FrickStore<Model> observable object cache + sync loop). A generic observable object cache keyed by type that subscribes over FrickSyncSocket, applies object deltas + removals, and exposes the collection as a StateFlow for Compose. Handles snapshot + live upsert/delete + reconnect resubscribe.
